description: Noon Sugar Mills Limited is a public company incorporated in 1964, which set up a plant in Punjab to manufacture white sugar; the plant began production in 1966 with a daily crushing capacity of 1,500 tons of cane. The company now operates a sugar mill and a distillery at Bhalwal, District Sargodha, and states that its sugar division holds ISO 9001:2015, FSSC 22000 and halal certification.
headOffice: 66-67-A, Garden Block, New Garden Town, Lahore, Pakistan
